primary_frame.population: CN-affiliated authorships with high-confidence ChineseNames-mappable surnames; no nationality/ethnicity inference

field_scope.rule: All current OpenAlex fields passing prospective primary-field data-volume and structured-order coverage thresholds; six anchor fields are feasibility anchors only.

work_eligibility: validated family-name evidence for all listed authors needed for whole-team RelAlphaRank
>=2 CN-affiliated ChineseNames-mappable focal authorships after exclusions

surname_measurement.chinese_population_baseline: ChineseNames 2025.8; confirmatory reproduction required from pinned package

identity.longitudinal_join_key: current canonical OpenAlex author ID after re-resolving embedded work author ID

primary_exposure.name: PriorFieldAlphabetizationExposure
mandatory_robustness: re-estimate convention using 3+ author works only
primary_exposure.field_assignment_rule: primary_topic.field.id only; topics.field.id is forbidden for primary context because works may have topics spanning multiple fields

source_field_lagged.rule: hierarchically shrink toward field × prior-3-year parent; raw source score may not replace primary based on effect strength

primary_predictor.name: RelAlphaRank
primary_predictor.definition: midrank-normalized family-name order within actual coauthor team
primary_predictor.rank_reference: entire actual author list, including non-focal coauthors

requirements: author dependence must be accounted for
shared work dependence must be accounted for

prohibited_adaptive_choices: choosing source-level exposure because it gives a larger surname interaction
using last-token surname parsing to increase sample size
changing the primary outcome to citations after seeing the position result
using a 2024-active survivor sample as the confirmatory career cohort
opening focal surname × career effects before preregistration freeze
